query.rawSQL: WITH nh AS ( SELECT coalesce(json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.client'), substr(target_id, 5)) AS client, max_by(json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.client_name'), ts_ms) AS host FROM heimdall.samples WHERE device = '$device' AND dt BETWEEN $__rawTimeFrom('yyyy-MM-dd') AND $__rawTimeTo('yyyy-MM-dd') AND ts_ms BETWEEN ${__from} AND ${__to} AND kind IN ('lan', 'flow') AND json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.client_name') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ), nm AS ( SELECT client, CASE WHEN count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY lower(host)) > 1 THEN host || ' #' || substr(client, 1, 4) ELSE host END AS label FROM nh WHERE NOT regexp_like(lower(host), '^(\*|localhost|unknown|none|wlan[0-9]*|eth[0-9]*|android[-_]?[0-9a-f]*|esp[-_][0-9a-f]+|espressif|[0-9a-f]{8,}|([0-9a-f]{2}[-:]?){6})$') ) SELECT DISTINCT coalesce(nm.label, json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.client')) AS client FROM heimdall.samples LEFT JOIN nm ON nm.client = json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.client') WHERE device = '$device' AND dt BETWEEN $__rawTimeFrom('yyyy-MM-dd') AND $__rawTimeTo('yyyy-MM-dd') AND ts_ms BETWEEN ${__from} AND ${__to} AND kind = 'flow' ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Connections of LAN clients (passive, every TCP and QUIC handshake)
Clients over the range
panels.description: lan is the client's reply time to the server's SYN-ACK, measured at the CPE: the Wi-Fi or Ethernet round trip plus the client's own delay. wan is SYN to SYN-ACK. unanswered are SYNs the server never answered.

targets.rawSQL: WITH nh AS ( SELECT coalesce(json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.client'), substr(target_id, 5)) AS client, max_by(json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.client_name'), ts_ms) AS host FROM heimdall.samples WHERE device = '$device' AND dt BETWEEN $__rawTimeFrom('yyyy-MM-dd') AND $__rawTimeTo('yyyy-MM-dd') AND ts_ms BETWEEN ${__from} AND ${__to} AND kind IN ('lan', 'flow') AND json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.client_name') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ), nm AS ( SELECT client, CASE WHEN count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY lower(host)) > 1 THEN host || ' #' || substr(client, 1, 4) ELSE host END AS label FROM nh WHERE NOT regexp_like(lower(host), '^(\*|localhost|unknown|none|wlan[0-9]*|eth[0-9]*|android[-_]?[0-9a-f]*|esp[-_][0-9a-f]+|espressif|[0-9a-f]{8,}|([0-9a-f]{2}[-:]?){6})$') ) , f AS ( SELECT ts_ms, CAST(from_unixtime((ts_ms / $__interval_ms) * $__interval_ms / 1000.0) AS timestamp) AS time, service, category, json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.client') AS client, coalesce(json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.node'), 'cpe') AS node, json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.medium') AS medium, json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.band') AS band, json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.proto') AS proto, CAST(json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.lan_ms') AS double) AS lan, CAST(json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.wan_ms') AS double) AS wan, CAST(json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.rssi') AS integer) AS rssi, status FROM heimdall.samples WHERE device = '$device' AND dt BETWEEN $__rawTimeFrom('yyyy-MM-dd') AND $__rawTimeTo('yyyy-MM-dd') AND ts_ms BETWEEN ${__from} AND ${__to} AND kind = 'flow' ) SELECT coalesce(arbitrary(nm.label), f.client) AS name, f.client AS client, arbitrary(node) AS node, arbitrary(medium) AS medium, arbitrary(band) AS band, count(*) AS flows, approx_percentile(lan, 0.5) FILTER (WHERE proto = 'tcp' AND status = 'ok') AS lan_p50, approx_percentile(lan, 0.9) FILTER (WHERE proto = 'tcp' AND status = 'ok') AS lan_p90, approx_percentile(wan, 0.5) FILTER (WHERE status = 'ok') AS wan_p50, 100.0 * count_if(status = 'timeout') / count(*) AS unanswered, avg(rssi) AS rssi FROM f LEFT JOIN nm ON nm.client = f.client GROUP BY f.client ORDER BY flows DESC

panels.title: LAN, WAN and LAN ping of $client
panels.description: The first echo of a burst waits for a client in power save to wake for a beacon; the rest show the awake round trip.

targets.rawSQL: WITH nh AS ( SELECT coalesce(json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.client'), substr(target_id, 5)) AS client, max_by(json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.client_name'), ts_ms) AS host FROM heimdall.samples WHERE device = '$device' AND dt BETWEEN $__rawTimeFrom('yyyy-MM-dd') AND $__rawTimeTo('yyyy-MM-dd') AND ts_ms BETWEEN ${__from} AND ${__to} AND kind IN ('lan', 'flow') AND json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.client_name') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ), nm AS ( SELECT client, CASE WHEN count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY lower(host)) > 1 THEN host || ' #' || substr(client, 1, 4) ELSE host sel AS (SELECT coalesce(max(client), '$client') AS id FROM nm WHERE label = '$client'), f AS ( SELECT ts_ms, CAST(from_unixtime((ts_ms / $__interval_ms) * $__interval_ms / 1000.0) AS timestamp) AS time, service, category, json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.client') AS client, coalesce(json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.node'), 'cpe') AS node, json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.medium') AS medium, json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.band') AS band, json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.proto') AS proto, CAST(json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.lan_ms') AS double) AS lan, CAST(json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.wan_ms') AS double) AS wan, CAST(json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.rssi') AS integer) AS rssi, status FROM heimdall.samples WHERE device = '$device' AND dt BETWEEN $__rawTimeFrom('yyyy-MM-dd') AND $__rawTimeTo('yyyy-MM-dd') AND ts_ms BETWEEN ${__from} AND ${__to} AND kind = 'flow' ) SELECT time, 'lan (tcp handshake)' AS metric, approx_percentile(lan, 0.5) AS value FROM f WHERE client = (SELECT id FROM sel) AND proto = 'tcp' AND status = 'ok' GROUP BY 1, 2 UNION ALL SELECT time, 'wan (tcp handshake)', approx_percentile(wan, 0.5) FROM f WHERE client = (SELECT id FROM sel) AND status = 'ok' GROUP BY 1, 2 UNION ALL SELECT CAST(from_unixtime((ts_ms / $__interval_ms) * $__interval_ms / 1000.0) AS timestamp), 'lan ping (best of burst)', approx_percentile(rtt_ms, 0.5) FROM heimdall.samples WHERE device = '$device' AND dt BETWEEN $__rawTimeFrom('yyyy-MM-dd') AND $__rawTimeTo('yyyy-MM-dd') AND ts_ms BETWEEN ${__from} AND ${__to} AND kind = 'lan' AND status = 'ok' AND target_id = 'lan/' || (SELECT id FROM sel) GROUP BY 1, 2 UNION ALL SELECT CAST(from_unixtime((ts_ms / $__interval_ms) * $__interval_ms / 1000.0) AS timestamp), 'lan ping (first of burst)', approx_percentile(CAST(json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.burst_ms[0]') AS double), 0.5) FROM heimdall.samples WHERE device = '$device' AND dt BETWEEN $__rawTimeFrom('yyyy-MM-dd') AND $__rawTimeTo('yyyy-MM-dd') AND ts_ms BETWEEN ${__from} AND ${__to} AND kind = 'lan' AND target_id = 'lan/' || (SELECT id FROM sel) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

WITH nh AS ( SELECT coalesce(json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.client'), substr(target_id, 5)) AS client, max_by(json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.client_name'), ts_ms) AS host FROM heimdall.samples WHERE device = '$device' AND dt BETWEEN $__rawTimeFrom('yyyy-MM-dd') AND $__rawTimeTo('yyyy-MM-dd') AND ts_ms BETWEEN ${__from} AND ${__to} AND kind IN ('lan', 'flow') AND json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.client_name') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ), nm AS ( SELECT client, CASE WHEN count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY lower(host)) > 1 THEN host || ' #' || substr(client, 1, 4) ELSE host END AS label FROM nh WHERE NOT regexp_like(lower(host), '^(\*|localhost|unknown|none|wlan[0-9]*|eth[0-9]*|android[-_]?[0-9a-f]*|esp[-_][0-9a-f]+|espressif|[0-9a-f]{8,}|([0-9a-f]{2}[-:]?){6})$') ) , sel AS (SELECT coalesce(max(client), '$client') AS id FROM nm WHERE label = '$client'), f AS ( SELECT ts_ms, CAST(from_unixtime((ts_ms / $__interval_ms) * $__interval_ms / 1000.0) AS timestamp) AS time, service, category, json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.client') AS client, coalesce(json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.node'), 'cpe') AS node, json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.medium') AS medium, json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.band') AS band, json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.proto') AS proto, CAST(json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.lan_ms') AS double) AS lan, CAST(json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.wan_ms') AS double) AS wan, CAST(json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.rssi') AS integer) AS rssi, status FROM heimdall.samples WHERE device = '$device' AND dt BETWEEN $__rawTimeFrom('yyyy-MM-dd') AND $__rawTimeTo('yyyy-MM-dd') AND ts_ms BETWEEN ${__from} AND ${__to} AND kind = 'flow' ) SELECT category, service, count(*) AS flows, approx_percentile(wan, 0.5) FILTER (WHERE status = 'ok') AS wan_p50, approx_percentile(wan, 0.9) FILTER (WHERE status = 'ok') AS wan_p90, approx_percentile(lan, 0.5) FILTER (WHERE proto = 'tcp' AND status = 'ok') AS lan_p50, count_if(status = 'timeout') AS unanswered FROM f WHERE client = (SELECT id FROM sel) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY flows DESC

panels.title: Signal (RSSI) by client
panels.description: Clients of the CPE come from wl; clients of mesh extenders from the EasyMesh topology.

targets.rawSQL: WITH nh AS ( SELECT coalesce(json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.client'), substr(target_id, 5)) AS client, max_by(json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.client_name'), ts_ms) AS host FROM heimdall.samples WHERE device = '$device' AND dt BETWEEN $__rawTimeFrom('yyyy-MM-dd') AND $__rawTimeTo('yyyy-MM-dd') AND ts_ms BETWEEN ${__from} AND ${__to} AND kind IN ('lan', 'flow') AND json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.client_name') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ), nm AS ( SELECT client, CASE WHEN count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY lower(host)) > 1 THEN host || ' #' || substr(client, 1, 4) ELSE host END AS label FROM nh WHERE NOT regexp_like(lower(host), '^(\*|localhost|unknown|none|wlan[0-9]*|eth[0-9]*|android[-_]?[0-9a-f]*|esp[-_][0-9a-f]+|espressif|[0-9a-f]{8,}|([0-9a-f]{2}[-:]?){6})$') ) SELECT CAST(from_unixtime((ts_ms / $__interval_ms) * $__interval_ms / 1000.0) AS timestamp) AS time, coalesce(nm.label, json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.client')) || ' ' || json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.node') || ' ' || json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.band') AS metric, avg(CAST(json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.rssi') AS double)) AS value FROM heimdall.samples LEFT JOIN nm ON nm.client = json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.client') WHERE device = '$device' AND dt BETWEEN $__rawTimeFrom('yyyy-MM-dd') AND $__rawTimeTo('yyyy-MM-dd') AND ts_ms BETWEEN ${__from} AND ${__to} AND kind = 'wifi_sta' AND json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.rssi') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Transmit retries to clients of the CPE

targets.rawSQL: WITH nh AS ( SELECT coalesce(json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.client'), substr(target_id, 5)) AS client, max_by(json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.client_name'), ts_ms) AS host FROM heimdall.samples WHERE device = '$device' AND dt BETWEEN $__rawTimeFrom('yyyy-MM-dd') AND $__rawTimeTo('yyyy-MM-dd') AND ts_ms BETWEEN ${__from} AND ${__to} AND kind IN ('lan', 'flow') AND json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.client_name') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ), nm AS ( SELECT client, CASE WHEN count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY lower(host)) > 1 THEN host || ' #' || substr(client, 1, 4) ELSE host END AS label FROM nh WHERE NOT regexp_like(lower(host), '^(\*|localhost|unknown|none|wlan[0-9]*|eth[0-9]*|android[-_]?[0-9a-f]*|esp[-_][0-9a-f]+|espressif|[0-9a-f]{8,}|([0-9a-f]{2}[-:]?){6})$') ) SELECT CAST(from_unixtime((ts_ms / $__interval_ms) * $__interval_ms / 1000.0) AS timestamp) AS time, coalesce(nm.label, json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.client')) AS metric, 100.0 * sum(CAST(json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.tx_retries') AS double)) / nullif(sum(CAST(json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.tx_sent') AS double)), 0) AS value FROM heimdall.samples LEFT JOIN nm ON nm.client = json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.client') WHERE device = '$device' AND dt BETWEEN $__rawTimeFrom('yyyy-MM-dd') AND $__rawTimeTo('yyyy-MM-dd') AND ts_ms BETWEEN ${__from} AND ${__to} AND kind = 'wifi_sta' AND json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.source') = 'wl' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Radio airtime
panels.description: busy: channel busy; obss: neighbouring networks; inbss: this network's clients; tx: the CPE transmitting.

targets.rawSQL: SELECT CAST(from_unixtime((ts_ms / $__interval_ms) * $__interval_ms / 1000.0) AS timestamp) AS time, json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.band') || ' ' || m.name AS metric, avg(m.v) AS value FROM heimdall.samples CROSS JOIN UNNEST( ARRAY['busy', 'obss', 'inbss', 'tx'], ARRAY[CAST(json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.chanim_busy') AS double), CAST(json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.chanim_obss') AS double), CAST(json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.chanim_inbss') AS double), CAST(json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.chanim_tx') AS double)]) AS m(name, v) WHERE device = '$device' AND dt BETWEEN $__rawTimeFrom('yyyy-MM-dd') AND $__rawTimeTo('yyyy-MM-dd') AND ts_ms BETWEEN ${__from} AND ${__to} AND kind = 'wifi_radio' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

WITH nh AS ( SELECT coalesce(json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.client'), substr(target_id, 5)) AS client, max_by(json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.client_name'), ts_ms) AS host FROM heimdall.samples WHERE device = '$device' AND dt BETWEEN $__rawTimeFrom('yyyy-MM-dd') AND $__rawTimeTo('yyyy-MM-dd') AND ts_ms BETWEEN ${__from} AND ${__to} AND kind IN ('lan', 'flow') AND json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.client_name') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ), nm AS ( SELECT client, CASE WHEN count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY lower(host)) > 1 THEN host || ' #' || substr(client, 1, 4) ELSE host END AS label FROM nh WHERE NOT regexp_like(lower(host), '^(\*|localhost|unknown|none|wlan[0-9]*|eth[0-9]*|android[-_]?[0-9a-f]*|esp[-_][0-9a-f]+|espressif|[0-9a-f]{8,}|([0-9a-f]{2}[-:]?){6})$') ) SELECT CAST(from_unixtime((ts_ms / $__interval_ms) * $__interval_ms / 1000.0) AS timestamp) AS time, coalesce(nm.label, json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.client')) || ' ' || json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.node') AS metric, avg(CAST(json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.tx_rate_mbps') AS double)) AS value FROM heimdall.samples LEFT JOIN nm ON nm.client = json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.client') WHERE device = '$device' AND dt BETWEEN $__rawTimeFrom('yyyy-MM-dd') AND $__rawTimeTo('yyyy-MM-dd') AND ts_ms BETWEEN ${__from} AND ${__to} AND kind = 'wifi_sta' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

WITH nh AS ( SELECT coalesce(json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.client'), substr(target_id, 5)) AS client, max_by(json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.client_name'), ts_ms) AS host FROM heimdall.samples WHERE device = '$device' AND dt BETWEEN $__rawTimeFrom('yyyy-MM-dd') AND $__rawTimeTo('yyyy-MM-dd') AND ts_ms BETWEEN ${__from} AND ${__to} AND kind IN ('lan', 'flow') AND json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.client_name') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ), nm AS ( SELECT client, CASE WHEN count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY lower(host)) > 1 THEN host || ' #' || substr(client, 1, 4) ELSE host END AS label FROM nh WHERE NOT regexp_like(lower(host), '^(\*|localhost|unknown|none|wlan[0-9]*|eth[0-9]*|android[-_]?[0-9a-f]*|esp[-_][0-9a-f]+|espressif|[0-9a-f]{8,}|([0-9a-f]{2}[-:]?){6})$') ) SELECT CAST(from_unixtime(ts_ms / 1000.0) AS timestamp) AS time, json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.event') AS event, coalesce(nm.label, json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.client')) AS client, json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.node') AS node, json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.band') AS band, coalesce(json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.from'), json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.prev_chanspec')) AS before, json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.chanspec') AS chanspec FROM heimdall.samples LEFT JOIN nm ON nm.client = json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.client') WHERE device = '$device' AND dt BETWEEN $__rawTimeFrom('yyyy-MM-dd') AND $__rawTimeTo('yyyy-MM-dd') AND ts_ms BETWEEN ${__from} AND ${__to} AND kind = 'event' AND json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.event') LIKE 'wifi\_%' ESCAPE '\' ORDER BY ts_ms DESC LIMIT 200

panels.title: Connect time: client vs CPE split
panels.description: The client device's TCP connects and the CPE's record of the same connections.

targets.rawSQL: WITH c AS ( SELECT ts_ms, service, rtt_ms AS client_ms, json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.local_ip') AS ip, CAST(json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.local_port') AS integer) AS port FROM heimdall.samples WHERE device = '$clientdev' AND dt BETWEEN $__rawTimeFrom('yyyy-MM-dd') AND $__rawTimeTo('yyyy-MM-dd') AND ts_ms BETWEEN ${__from} AND ${__to} AND kind = 'tcp' AND target_id LIKE 'client/%' AND status = 'ok' AND target_id <> 'client/gateway-tcp' ), f AS ( SELECT ts_ms, json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.client_ip') AS ip, CAST(json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.client_port') AS integer) AS port, CAST(json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.wan_ms') AS double) AS wan, CAST(json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.lan_ms') AS double) AS lan FROM heimdall.samples WHERE device = '$device' AND dt BETWEEN $__rawTimeFrom('yyyy-MM-dd') AND $__rawTimeTo('yyyy-MM-dd') AND ts_ms BETWEEN ${__from} AND ${__to} AND kind = 'flow' AND status = 'ok' AND json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.proto') = 'tcp' ), m AS ( SELECT c.ts_ms, c.service, c.client_ms, f.wan, f.lan FROM c JOIN f ON c.ip = f.ip AND c.port = f.port AND abs(c.ts_ms - f.ts_ms) < 5000 ) SELECT CAST(from_unixtime((ts_ms / $__interval_ms) * $__interval_ms / 1000.0) AS timestamp) AS time, 'client connect' AS metric, approx_percentile(client_ms, 0.5) AS value FROM m GROUP BY 1, 2 UNION ALL SELECT CAST(from_unixtime((ts_ms / $__interval_ms) * $__interval_ms / 1000.0) AS timestamp), 'cpe wan + lan', approx_percentile(wan + lan, 0.5) FROM m GROUP BY 1, 2 UNION ALL SELECT CAST(from_unixtime((ts_ms / $__interval_ms) * $__interval_ms / 1000.0) AS timestamp), 'cpe wan', approx_percentile(wan, 0.5) FROM m GROUP BY 1, 2 UNION ALL SELECT CAST(from_unixtime((ts_ms / $__interval_ms) * $__interval_ms / 1000.0) AS timestamp), 'cpe lan', approx_percentile(lan, 0.5) FROM m GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Client vs CPE by service
panels.description: gap is what the client sees beyond the CPE's split: its own network stack and the parts of the LAN path the handshake does not cover.

targets.rawSQL: WITH c AS ( SELECT ts_ms, service, rtt_ms AS client_ms, json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.local_ip') AS ip, CAST(json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.local_port') AS integer) AS port FROM heimdall.samples WHERE device = '$clientdev' AND dt BETWEEN $__rawTimeFrom('yyyy-MM-dd') AND $__rawTimeTo('yyyy-MM-dd') AND ts_ms BETWEEN ${__from} AND ${__to} AND kind = 'tcp' AND target_id LIKE 'client/%' AND status = 'ok' AND target_id <> 'client/gateway-tcp' ), f AS ( SELECT ts_ms, json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.client_ip') AS ip, CAST(json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.client_port') AS integer) AS port, CAST(json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.wan_ms') AS double) AS wan, CAST(json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.lan_ms') AS double) AS lan FROM heimdall.samples WHERE device = '$device' AND dt BETWEEN $__rawTimeFrom('yyyy-MM-dd') AND $__rawTimeTo('yyyy-MM-dd') AND ts_ms BETWEEN ${__from} AND ${__to} AND kind = 'flow' AND status = 'ok' AND json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.proto') = 'tcp' ), m AS ( SELECT c.ts_ms, c.service, c.client_ms, f.wan, f.lan FROM c JOIN f ON c.ip = f.ip AND c.port = f.port AND abs(c.ts_ms - f.ts_ms) < 5000 ) SELECT service, count(*) AS matched, approx_percentile(client_ms, 0.5) AS client_p50, approx_percentile(wan, 0.5) AS cpe_wan_p50, approx_percentile(lan, 0.5) AS cpe_lan_p50, approx_percentile(client_ms - wan - lan, 0.5) AS gap_p50 FROM m GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Client to CPE: client's view vs CPE's view

targets.rawSQL: SELECT CAST(from_unixtime((ts_ms / $__interval_ms) * $__interval_ms / 1000.0) AS timestamp) AS time, 'client icmp to cpe' AS metric, approx_percentile(rtt_ms, 0.5) AS value FROM heimdall.samples WHERE device = '$clientdev' AND dt BETWEEN $__rawTimeFrom('yyyy-MM-dd') AND $__rawTimeTo('yyyy-MM-dd') AND ts_ms BETWEEN ${__from} AND ${__to} AND target_id = 'client/gateway' AND status = 'ok' GROUP BY 1, 2 UNION ALL SELECT CAST(from_unixtime((ts_ms / $__interval_ms) * $__interval_ms / 1000.0) AS timestamp), 'client tcp to cpe', approx_percentile(rtt_ms, 0.5) FROM status = 'ok' GROUP BY 1, 2 UNION ALL SELECT CAST(from_unixtime((ts_ms / $__interval_ms) * $__interval_ms / 1000.0) AS timestamp), 'cpe lan (handshakes of client)', approx_percentile(lan, 0.5) FROM ( device = '$clientdev' AND dt BETWEEN $__rawTimeFrom('yyyy-MM-dd') AND $__rawTimeTo('yyyy-MM-dd') AND ts_ms BETWEEN ${__from} AND ${__to} AND kind = 'tcp' AND target_id LIKE 'client/%' AND status = 'ok' AND target_id <> 'client/gateway-tcp' ), f AS ( SELECT ts_ms, json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.client_ip') AS ip, CAST(json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.client_port') AS integer) AS port, CAST(json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.wan_ms') AS double) AS wan, CAST(json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.lan_ms') AS double) AS lan FROM heimdall.samples WHERE device = '$device' AND dt BETWEEN $__rawTimeFrom('yyyy-MM-dd') AND $__rawTimeTo('yyyy-MM-dd') AND ts_ms BETWEEN ${__from} AND ${__to} AND kind = 'flow' AND status = 'ok' AND json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.proto') = 'tcp' ), m AS ( SELECT c.ts_ms, c.service, c.client_ms, f.wan, f.lan FROM c JOIN f ON c.ip = f.ip AND c.port = f.port AND abs(c.ts_ms - f.ts_ms) < 5000 ) SELECT ts_ms, lan FROM m) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT CAST(from_unixtime((ts_ms / $__interval_ms) * $__interval_ms / 1000.0) AS timestamp) AS time, m.name AS metric, avg(m.v) AS value FROM heimdall.samples CROSS JOIN UNNEST( ARRAY['rssi', 'noise'], ARRAY[CAST(json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.rssi') AS double), CAST(json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.noise') AS double)]) AS m(name, v) WHERE device = '$clientdev' AND dt BETWEEN $__rawTimeFrom('yyyy-MM-dd') AND $__rawTimeTo('yyyy-MM-dd') AND ts_ms BETWEEN ${__from} AND ${__to} AND kind = 'wifi_sta' AND target_id = 'client/wifi' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1
